property_summary: For any caller address X, if X is not the contract's deployer (initial owner), then calling setOwner(X) must fail (revert) on the reference because only the owner can call setOwner; the mutant that removes the require allows a non-owner caller to successfully change owner, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change the require in onlyOwner to require(true) effectively removing the access check so anyone can call setOwner and thus can change owner.
